verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a high-performance relay that Enterprise customers can place in their own firewall, and it says connections are otherwise peer-to-peer and never pass through Parsec's infrastructure. That is a direct but thinly documented, tier-gated way to keep session traffic on customer-run infrastructure. missing for 10: deployment or self-hosting docs for the relay, any self-hostable rendezvous/signaling or coordination service, availability below Enterprise tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run

citations.quote: The Parsec high-performance relay is also available to Enterprise customers so your team can connect through a relay point in your firewall.
All connections traveling through Parsec are peer-to-peer. They never pass through Parsec's infrastructure
a high-performance relay server adds even more control.
